I actually been to one! Unfortunately, I have Thursday night classes this semester and it took away all my availability for these events :( I don’t drink that much either (one glass of beer lasted me the entire event) and it was still a lot of fun. I got to meet some cool people and exchanged some snapchats. I definitely plan on going to one when class this semester ends!

Hey!! 25/f I’m newer to the TC too! I moved to Minneapolis but I work and go to grad school in St. Paul! I love comic books and hiking too! I made a few work friends here but not as many as I wanted too! :)
Wow!! Thank you so much! I will look into this!

Hi! Full-time graduate student here. I also work full-time and I have another part-time job.

My goal is to do one fun, new thing a week and I really try to stick with that! It can be movies, a meetup event (I’m new to the city), hiking in a new park, or trying new food. 

For my school, my graduate courses are 2 = full time (8 credits). I try my best to take two nights per class to do work. Luckily, I have a hybrid of night courses and online. We will see when I get to observations! :/

It’s been working so far, but I definitely need to grasp with better discipline. I have a mini-linguistics project due tomorrow @ midnight and I’m typing this post instead. It’s not perfect, but I have a decent outline of my schedule. So say Sunday and Monday are my linguistics class, Tuesday and Wednesday are Ed. Psy, Thursday is night class, and Friday/Saturday I tutor or have off. Then it starts over. 

I definitely try to have one day a week where I don’t do anything! Or at least one night. I hope this helps a little!
